description: This file defines an abstract class `AbstractNodeVisitor` in the Twig templating engine's NodeVisitor namespace. It provides foundational methods for visiting nodes during template compilation, including methods for entering and leaving nodes, intended to be overridden by subclasses.
external_methods: Twig	raits inal public function enterNode(Node $node, Environment $env): Node
Twig	raits inal public function leaveNode(Node $node, Environment $env): ?Node

classes.name: AbstractNodeVisitor
classes.description: An abstract base class for creating node visitors in Twig, providing common implementation for node traversal, compatible with Twig 1.x and 2.x, marked as deprecated since version 3.9.

methods.name: enterNode
methods.description: Final method called when entering a node, delegates to doEnterNode.

methods.name: leaveNode
methods.description: Final method called when leaving a node, delegates to doLeaveNode.

methods.name: doEnterNode
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented by subclasses for custom behavior upon entering a node.

methods.name: doLeaveNode
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented by subclasses for custom behavior upon leaving a node.

calls: Twig	raits inal public function enterNode
Twig	raits inal public function leaveNode
